notes: Improved Outfit Collection so a verified replacement-catalyst shortage skips only the affected outfit instead of stopping the full reviewed run.
Fixed automations choosing the Pockie Ninja landing/server tab instead of the active logged-in game tab when multiple Pockie Ninja tabs are open.
Fixed Sichibukai Load/Start so it attaches to the live game tab and opens the required setup from there.
Fixed Ninja's Trial duplicate-browser behavior after Stop and Start.
Improved shared browser reuse and game-page recovery across supported automations.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Fixed Outfit Collection stopping the full run after a failed synthesis when the Main Item survived but replacement catalysts were no longer available; the item is now returned safely to Inventory and the target is marked Waiting for Catalyst.
Fixed Sichibukai Load attaching to the wrong Pockie Ninja tab when both the landing/server page and a logged-in game tab are open.
Fixed supported automations using the first matching Pockie Ninja URL instead of identifying the active in-game page.
Fixed Ninja's Trial using stale saved browser/CDP settings that could cause another browser to open after Stop → Start.
Fixed shared browser cleanup/restart cases that could interfere with browser reuse.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Outfit Collection now continues with the next completable target after safely skipping an outfit that cannot refill verified synthesis catalyst slots.
Added shared live game-tab selection using visible in-game UI markers and the active tab state.

Applied the shared tab-selection behavior to Sichibukai, Ninja Trial, Konoha Boutique, Slot Machine, Tailed Beast, Valhalla, Las Noches, Arena, Clan Boss/Garden, Outfit Collection, Auto Sell, and Outdoor Exploration.
Existing Pockie Ninja game tabs keep their current server and session when automations are restarted.
New browser sessions continue to open https://pockieninja.online/ by default.
